actual_visual_review.method: Actual original-resolution view_image inspection of all38 selected PNGs; no crop pixels resized.
findings: Actual viewing finds coherent larger bark structure but attenuated fine hairs, grass and wood grain. Differences among the four restored methods are subtle.
Fine hairs and grass/wood texture remain smeared, especially in the deepest cases; colored blotches persist. No clear large new recovery is visible.
Normal8-bit faint panels look almost identical. The shared40× boards reveal residual colored texture and softened fine detail, without a clear broad new recovery by V137.
Foliage remains soft/painterly, larger fence/building geometry coherent and sky quiet. No clear large new detail recovery is visible.

The nominal profile still largely erases the fine lattice. The nearby profile retains weak irregular diagonal texture in all four models, without a clear new correct-lattice recovery. The left blue point persists.

report_text.TITLE: stronger memory adaptation, mixed quality
report_text.CONCLUSION: Normalized matching improves faint-ADC scores over V136, without a clear large recovery of weak photographic detail or real fine mesh.
report_text.RECOMMENDATION: V120 Small remains the general recommendation.
report_text.MAIN_FINDING: Against matched V136, ordinary/shadow means fall about.0005–.0044dB while faint ADC rises.03339dB. The faint mean remains.01696dB below V120. These finite gains and regressions are shown directly.
report_text.ORDINARY_FINDING: Compared with V136, all four selected band errors fall, while fur/wood projected gains fall; grass response rises only slightly. Lower band error does not establish uniformly better detail response.
report_text.MATERIAL_VIEWING: Actual viewing finds coherent larger bark structure but attenuated fine hairs, grass and wood grain. Differences among the four restored methods are subtle.
report_text.SHADOW_VIEWING: Fine hairs and grass/wood texture remain smeared, especially in the deepest cases; colored blotches persist. No clear large new recovery is visible.
report_text.FAINT_FINDING: Relative to V136, fur2–5% improves in projected gain and error. Weaker fur0–2% and wood lose some gain while errors fall; grass worsens in both. Pooled sRGB MSE and centered spatial MSE decrease, while the ROI-mean error component grows. V120 still has slightly lower pooled total/spatial errors overall.
report_text.FAINT_VIEWING: Normal8-bit faint panels look almost identical. The shared40× boards reveal residual colored texture and softened fine detail, without a clear broad new recovery by V137.
report_text.LEARNING_FINDING: V137's write-query/key EMA drifts are4.89e−5/5.11e−5, versus V136's4.21e−10/5.17e−10 against the same CPU decay reference. Adaptation is therefore measurably stronger. This does not establish its causal contribution to restoration quality. The independent audit checks720 state/Adam norm fields and1,008 snapshot-metadata entries; raw gradient arrays are not independently recomputed.
report_text.GFX_VIEWING: Foliage remains soft/painterly, larger fence/building geometry coherent and sky quiet. No clear large new detail recovery is visible.
report_text.MESH_VIEWING: The nominal profile still largely erases the fine lattice. The nearby profile retains weak irregular diagonal texture in all four models, without a clear new correct-lattice recovery. The left blue point persists.
report_text.FINAL_DECISION: No20k conditioned-global run is queued from this result. Keep normalized matching as an explicit experimental operator and retain its narrow faint-detail strengths, without presenting this pilot as a general quality improvement. Stronger memory adaptation alone has not resolved the missing photographic detail.

actual_visual_review.recommendation: V120 Small remains general recommendation. V137 improves faint-ADC mean and selected spatial errors over V136, with tiny ordinary/shadow regressions, mixed projected detail gains and no clear new real-mesh recovery. Retain the measured strengths without a general promotion.
actual_visual_review.unviewed_primary_triplets: Audited pixel subsets of actually viewed comparison boards; not separately claimed as viewed.

recommendation: V120 Small remains general recommendation. V137 improves faint-ADC mean and selected spatial errors over V136, with tiny ordinary/shadow regressions, mixed projected detail gains and no clear new real-mesh recovery. Retain the measured strengths without a general promotion.
limits: Full original1000 pilot endpoint, not20k or full427 photo/camera/color/fullframe. Four material contexts/one draw perCFA; native binned refs approximate. Conditioned mixing compared with saved V136 control on exact matched training inputs; V120 comparison also includes continued training.
